why: The cost table is keyed by (kind, device, phase, batch, tokens, visible_history). These are the keys a device must fill for every model. Batch 1 is the declared use case (personal inference, latency target); the history axis is what distinguishes prefill from decode, so it is swept rather than assumed.
not_interpolated: A shape not listed here must be measured, not derived from a neighbour (R4). Missing keys stay null, not zero.
